The full ISHS 2026 conference schedule brings together researchers, students, and professionals from around the world for five days of academic activities dedicated to humor studies. The program includes keynote lectures, panel sessions, paper presentations, workshops, and cultural activities designed to foster interdisciplinary dialogue and international exchange.

On this page, you will find detailed information about session times, rooms, and event activities, as well as updates regarding special events and possible schedule changes throughout the conference.
